newsitem.title: LATVIA: SINGAPORE'S TOLARAM BUYS DAUTEKS TEXTILE PLANT.
newsitem.headline: SINGAPORE'S TOLARAM BUYS DAUTEKS TEXTILE PLANT.

text.p: Singapore's Tolaram Group bought the Dauteks textile company in Latvia's second largest town of Daugavpils for one lat, the privatisation agency said on Monday.

The agency said in a statement that the purchase of the plant for one lat was part of a plan to restructure and privatise the ailing mill, one of the largest employers in the region of eastern Latvia.
"The privatisation agency and Tolaram Group expressed the wish to continue the agreed restructuring plan to make Dautek solvent again," the agency said in a statement.
Tolaram also owns a textile mill in Estonia as well as a pulp and paper plant.
